expectations: stamping, cancelling or creating fiscal documents

area: app/models/fiscal.py (no stored totals or issuer seal; XML in fiscal_document_xml.data)
area: spec 019 rendering core app/rendering/ and app/services/print_contexts.py

intent: Read fiscal documents, download their stamped XML, and print CFDI 4.0 documents as the legacy Print40T02Blue content with the SAT QR

decisions.decision: Print every amount, code, seal, UUID and date from the stamped XML; DB only for catalog descriptions, line comments and cancellation date
decisions.why: No stored totals or issuer seal; QR tt must equal the stamped total; 377/377 sampled seals and UUIDs match
decisions.rejected: Legacy approach of printing DB columns and recomputing totals

decisions.decision: Rebuild the TFD 1.1 original string from the XML
decisions.why: Equals stored original_string on 377/377; seven fields, no XSLT needed
decisions.rejected: lxml + SAT XSLT, or printing the stored copy

decisions.decision: segno SVG QR inlined as data URI; escape only & in RFCs as %26
decisions.why: One recipient RFC has & which breaks legacy QR; 1,674 docs with Ñ keep legacy raw form
decisions.rejected: qrcode lib; anonymous QR image route; full percent-encoding

decisions.why: Stored PAC output; expat blocks external entities and limits expansion

decisions.decision: Batch template parsed with ast.literal_eval, defaults on any failure; logo by file name under images_dir
decisions.why: All templates are single-quoted; logo path points into legacy app
decisions.rejected: json.loads after quote rewrite; bundling tenant logo

decisions.decision: Status from completed/cancelled: draft/issued/cancelled; XML route needs issued, PDF needs 4.0 + stamp
decisions.why: CFD 2.0/2.2 are issued with XML but never stamped
decisions.rejected: Status from stamp_uuid, which mislabels 6,866 CFDs as drafts

decisions.decision: List total read from page rows XML
decisions.why: No totals column; <=100 rows of ~5.9 KB
decisions.rejected: SQL recomputation, REGEXP_SUBSTR (MariaDB-only, tests on SQLite), new column

decisions.decision: Plain-string 409 details, distinct per case, checked in fixed order
Keep Ñ raw in the QR payload; correction: no stamped 4.0 document has Ñ in an RFC (the earlier 1,674 was a utf8mb4_general_ci collation artifact)
decisions.why: Matches legacy; affects no real document today

decisions.decision: fiscal_document.html is a standalone letter template linking print.css
decisions.why: The CFDI header is title, folio, UUID and parties, not the store block _print_layout prints

decisions.decision: CFDI page rules on a named page (@page cfdi, body.cfdi)
decisions.why: An unscoped @page margin box would stamp a page counter onto the spec 019 pedido

decisions.decision: Page counter in a @bottom-right margin box; legend and accounts in a running element
decisions.why: Margin-box counters are reliable in WeasyPrint 70

decisions.decision: Reuse qty for 0.####; add price4 for #,###.00##; no new Jinja filters
decisions.why: qty already matched legacy; contexts pre-format every value

decisions.decision: QR as segno full SVG with viewBox (omitsize) and no border
decisions.why: svg_inline lacks xmlns and viewBox, so an img data URI would not render or scale

decisions.decision: Extracted _image_uri from header_context for the CFDI logo
decisions.why: Same file-name-only lookup under images_dir, one implementation

plan.summary: Plan: read-only /fiscal-documents router (list, detail, xml, pdf) with a CFDI XML module and one template on the spec 019 core; one new dependency (segno)
plan.key_finding: Every printed value is in the stamped XML and matches stored seals/UUIDs; only descriptions, line comments and the cancellation date come from the DB

tasks.summary: 30 tasks in 7 phases after analyze remediation: route tests merged into their route tasks (T018, T019), lowercase total for CFD/CFDI 3.2, SC-005 in T030, currency mapping for amount in words

implement.summary: Four /fiscal-documents routes and the CFDI 4.0 PDF for all four types; 29/30 tasks, T030 open pending legacy PDFs and a phone scan

approach: Parse the stored stamped XML with ElementTree into plain dicts; build the render context from it plus catalog descriptions, line comments and the cancellation date; render one Jinja template on the spec 019 WeasyPrint core with a segno SVG QR and a running footer. Routes live in a new fiscal_documents router backed by a service that derives status from completed/cancelled.
